name: 2027 Prairie Avenue — brick villa of two and a half storeys with a front bay, a canted north bay and a two-storey rear range, K01 frontage assembly

function.note: The 1911 sheet marks the building 'D' (dwelling): '2½B brick dwelling (D)'. Carried to 1904 on the T-1842 census ruling (present_as_mapped).

research_note: T-3635 (piece 3 of T-1917) refines the district draft (T-2352) in place under the same id: the house is rebuilt from the K01 frontage assembly and its kits — K03 brick on every wall, K06 sash, K07 door and stoop, a K08 full-height front bay and canted north bay, K09 cornice-hood lintels, K10 bracketed cornice, a K04/K05 slate hip with a K05 street dormer — and the sheet's two-storey rear range on K01's rear wings, instead of the draft builder. What is read: sheet 35 of the 1911 Sanborn at full size (storeys '2½B', brick, 'D', the plan with its front bay, its canted north bay, its open stoop at the south corner and its rear range '2B') through the T-1842 census, which rules it present in 1904. The register associates the house with Silas B. Cobb's household, an open association, so the id names no one. No photograph, plate or description of the house is known (the T-1917 brief: 'no picture'), so it is a bounded design on the brief's 'restrained roof and openings': every height, opening, roof and detail is the kits' reconstruction under liberty L-k01-2027-villa-3635, and a later reading that finds a picture replaces those choices. Not built: the rear range's one-storey frame bay and the frame shed beside it. The alley barn (house_2027_prairie_coach_house) is the R series' and is untouched. Review: docs/RESEARCH/k01-2027-villa-3635/README.md.

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: the 1911 sheet draws the building and the T-1842 census rules it present in 1904 (present_as_mapped). Its building and loss dates are the per-building ticket's to read.

position.symbolic_location: 2027 S. Prairie Avenue, parcel prairie_2027 (data/street_grid/1904.json), east side of Prairie Avenue, Prairie Avenue, 20th to 22nd Street (Sanborn 1911 vol. 3 sheet 35).
position.note: The rear corner of the main body on its north side (this frame's v 0), read off sheet 35 of the 1911 Sanborn at full size (T-3635) and carried into this frame through an affine fit of the committed trace's pixel/metre pairs (data/traces/prairie_1904_footprints_s35.json, 0.186 m a pixel): the rear wall at column 1014 and the main north wall at row 694. The sheet's georeference carries no independent check: its own fit residual is 0.05 m RMS on its control crossings, plus about a pixel (0.19 m) of reading on this copy. The draft's rectangle fit stood its corner 5.9 m further east (column 1045.6), its 22.5 m depth running into the rear range. Rotation 179.389 degrees (the draft's) turns the plan's u axis onto the lot's own rear-to-street line.

derivation.reason: The four derivation methods re-derive from the 1835 files; this position is re-derived from the traced sheet and the 1904 parcel by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py --check instead.

footprint.note: The main body, read off sheet 35 of the 1911 Sanborn at full size (T-3635) and carried into this frame through an affine fit of the committed trace's pixel/metre pairs (data/traces/prairie_1904_footprints_s35.json, 0.186 m a pixel): 16.91 m from the rear wall (column 1014) to the front's north part (column 923), and 12.82 m along the front from the north wall (row 694) to the south wall on the lot line with 2029 (row 763). The front bay, the canted north bay and the rear range are form.bays and form.rear_wings. The draft's fit drew it 22.5 m by 11.5 m, across the rear range's line.

stories.note: '2½B' printed on the 1911 sheet over the house (T-1842 census s35-2027-front, '2½B brick dwelling (D)'): two full storeys of brick and a half storey in the roof, which the street dormer lights.

construction.note: The sheet colours the whole house pink (brick), front and flanks alike, with no blue (stone) band: the census reads 'brick dwelling'.

bays.note: The plan's two projections, read off sheet 35 of the 1911 Sanborn at full size (T-3635) and carried into this frame through an affine fit of the committed trace's pixel/metre pairs (data/traces/prairie_1904_footprints_s35.json, 0.186 m a pixel). FRONT: the front's south part stands out of its north part, the outer line at column 915-917 against the north part's front wall at 923, from row 723 to row 751 (v 5.39-10.59 from the main north wall, row 694): a full-height K08 projection 5.2 m wide, built 1.2 m out (the sheet's 1.3 m less the double line's width). NORTH FLANK: the sheet's canted bay on the north wall, its foot from column 976 to 1002.5 (u 2.14-7.16 from the rear wall, column 1014), its face from 980 to 998.5 at row 689, 0.93 m out: a K08 canted bay 5.02 m at the wall and 3.54 m at its face, carried two storeys under its own low hip, one light a storey in its face and its shallow cants blind (a 0.93 m bay leaves no room for a light behind a cant). The front bay rises to the main cornice's bed moulding (8.349 m) and carries the bracketed cornice round its face under the house's eave, so its chamber storey is 2.949 m. Every window, height and roof on both is reconstructed (L-k01-2027-villa-3635)

rear_wings.note: The sheet's rear range ('2B', T-1842 census s35-2027-wing: 'Rear two-storey range ("rear2B") and a one-storey frame shed'), read off sheet 35 of the 1911 Sanborn at full size (T-3635) and carried into this frame through an affine fit of the committed trace's pixel/metre pairs (data/traces/prairie_1904_footprints_s35.json, 0.186 m a pixel): columns 1014-1058.5 (8.27 m behind the main rear wall) and rows 705-748 (v 2.04-10.04), two storeys. Its floor, storey heights, windows and flat tin deck are reconstructed (L-k01-2027-villa-3635). The one-storey frame (yellow) canted bay on its east end and the one-storey frame shed south of it (rows 748-763, columns 1047-1072) are not built: K01 stands a wing only on the main rear wall or a wing's rear, and a frame bay on a wing's end is not in the kit.

boundary.note: RECONSTRUCTED: no boundary across the front: no picture of this front is held and the district draft stood none; the lot's sides are parcel prairie_2027's in this frame (sheet rows 681.5 and 763). (L-k01-2027-villa-3635)
